name: Tim Hauke
availability: Open to client projects, freelance work and a permanent position. Remote, on site or hybrid.
summary: I plan, build and run software for companies, from the first sketch to the server it runs on.
about: I'm Tim, a self-taught full-stack developer from Itzehoe in northern Germany. I founded UplyTech, a community and project for development, design, video and marketing. There I build websites, web apps, APIs and custom software, and I host and maintain what I ship.

I started coding in 2017 and learned from YouTube tutorials. That led to PlayGS, a Minecraft network with its own plugins, a shop and a TeamSpeak server, which I ran until 2019. Most of my own projects began as fixes for my own problems, like a music bot for my Discord server or a script that redeploys apps when I push.
Right now most of my time goes into Tellersonne, a cooking app for iOS and Android.
services: Company websites, web apps and dashboards, usually Next.js, React or Vue with a Node.js or Laravel backend
Custom software such as internal tools, admin panels, CLIs and Electron desktop apps
REST and GraphQL APIs with authentication, and Discord bots with their own web dashboard
Linux servers with Docker and Nginx, CI/CD on GitHub Actions, hosting and technical support
AI and automation: connecting tools and automating repetitive work
IT consulting when you need to pick a stack, scope a project or clean up an existing codebase
